title: 第169章 刘业：我是煞笔
slug: 让我开早餐店我下午才营业
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

信息发送出去。

很快，老马第一个回复了，“怎么了刘姐？我看装修挺好的啊。”

张强也冒了泡，“我看价格不便宜。”

刘姐直接发了一条语音。

“装修好顶个屁用！纯纯的骗局。我刚进去点了一份68的小笼包。端上来一看就是超市冷柜里那种速冻包装货！吃了一口，皮是僵的，肉是柴的，里面还是冰的！全是预制菜！微波炉加热到一半就端出来了！好歹给我加热好啊！”

这条语音一出，群里瞬间炸了锅。

周鹏：“卧槽。68块钱买一份微波炉速冻包子？这老板心真黑啊。”

李哥发了个愤怒的表情包，“这不是欺负老实人吗？还是范老板实在。现揉现包，肉馅那叫一个新鲜。”

楚轻轻：“坚决抵制！避雷避雷！”

刘姐继续打字，“大家相互转告。去吃的都是冤大头。别去浪费钱。有那闲钱，不如去侧门排队吃范老板的面。”

群里一呼百应。

“收到。”

“谁去谁傻子。”

“已拉黑。”

消息飞速刷屏。群里所有人达成了一致共识。

正门的那家店，已经被打入了死牢。

中午十二点。

刘姐的避雷语音还在群里被反复引用。各种表情包刷得飞起。

手机屏幕前，刘业摸了摸圆滚滚的肚子。

作为本市有名的老吃家，全城大大小小的馆子他基本都吃过。他不是不信刘姐的话，而是出于一种吃货的诡异好奇心。

“真有这么难吃？”刘业盯着黑底金字的招牌照片嘀咕道。

他决定亲自去蹚一蹚这浑水。

十分钟后，刘业推开了颜晨宴的玻璃门。

灰色的墙面，暖黄的灯光，冷气开得很足。林雪走过来地递上菜单。

“一碗牛肉面。”刘业扫了一眼价格，88元。

不到五分钟，面端了上来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The message is sent.

Soon, Lao Ma was the first to reply, "What's wrong, Sister Liu? I think the decoration is quite good."

Zhang Qiang was also excited, "I think the price is not cheap."

Sister Liu directly sent a voice message.

"The decoration is useless! What a pure scam. I just went in and ordered a 68 xiaolongbao. When it was served, it looked like the kind of quick-frozen packaged goods in the supermarket freezer! After taking a bite, the skin was stiff, the meat was wood, and the inside was still cold! They were all pre-made dishes! They were brought out after heating them in the microwave! At least you can heat them up for me!"

As soon as this voice came out, the group immediately exploded.

Zhou Peng: "Damn it. 68 yuan for a microwave-frozen bun? This boss has such a dark heart."

Brother Li posted an angry emoji, "Isn't this bullying an honest person? Boss Fan is still honest. The buns are freshly kneaded and the meat filling is fresh."

Chu Qingqing: "Resolutely resist! Avoid lightning and lightning!"

Sister Liu continued typing, "Let's tell each other. Everyone who goes to eat is taken advantage of. Don't waste your money. If you have that spare money, why not go to the side door and queue up to eat Boss Fan's noodles."

The group responded to every call.

"Roger that."

"Whoever goes is a fool."

"Blocked."

Messages flooded the screen rapidly.Everyone in the group reached a unanimous consensus.

The store at the front entrance has been put on death row.

Twelve noon.

Sister Liu’s lightning protection voice is still quoted repeatedly in the group.All kinds of emoticons flew up.

In front of the mobile phone screen, Liu Ye touched his round belly.

As a well-known old foodie in the city, he has eaten in basically all the restaurants of all sizes in the city.It's not that he doesn't believe Sister Liu's words, but it's out of a strange foodie curiosity.

"Is it really so unpalatable?" Liu Ye muttered, staring at the signboard photo with gold characters on a black background.

He decided to take a dip in the muddy waters himself.

Ten minutes later, Liu Ye pushed open the glass door of Yan Chenyan.

Gray walls, warm yellow lights, and the air conditioner is fully turned on.Lin Xue came over and handed over the menu.

"A bowl of beef noodles." Liu Ye glanced at the price, 88 yuan.

In less than five minutes, the noodles were served.
